jobs.occupation: Business Analyst Odoo - Business Services - Brussels
jobs.description:
Are you passionate about digital transformation and business process optimization? Do you enjoy working closely with stakeholders to translate business needs into effective ERP solutions? If you're looking for a role that combines impact, learning, and career growth, this opportunity could be for you.

As an Odoo Business Analyst, you will support clients throughout their digital transformation journey, helping them leverage Odoo to streamline processes and improve operational efficiency.Your responsibilities will include:

• Gathering and analyzing business requirements across multiple departments.
• Facilitating workshops with key stakeholders and end users.
• Translating business needs into functional Odoo solutions.
• Supporting ERP implementation projects from analysis to go-live.
• Working closely with consultants, developers, and project managers.
• Defining and executing testing scenarios to ensure successful delivery.
• Driving user adoption and continuous process improvement initiatives.

Profile

• Experience as a Business Analyst, Functional Analyst, ERP Consultant, or a similar role.
• Knowledge of Odoo ERP or experience with other ERP platforms.
• Strong understanding of business processes such as Finance, Supply Chain, Operations, HR, or CRM.
• Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills.
• Fluent in French and Dutch, with a good command of English.
• Solution-oriented mindset and strong analytical abilities.

Evolve into a Subject Matter Expert:

• Eager in learning successful implementation of IAM solutions in a complex environment.
• Learn to be a liaison to business, technology and project management partners and learn to act as an IAM advocate for technology initiatives while guiding the organisation in modelling of Business roles and onboarding of applications.
• Get to know IAM processes and discover opportunities and solutions for improvement, automation and streamlined integration.
• Help conducting maturity assessments and technology gap analysis for the IAM program.
• Learn to translate business requests into functional requirements.
Get familiar with Governance & compliancy:

• Learn all about compliance regulations and policies and how they reflect in IAM
• Collaborate with IT, Audit, and other oversight teams to understand and remedy audit findings.
• Answer general inquiries regarding information security practice or security access.
• Discover recommendations for implementing desired level of access controls.
• Assist in implementing action plans to address system access issues.
• Identify, define/approve and implement continuous process.
Develop reporting skills:

• Develop reporting methods and ensure that metrics are captured and reported for the team to monitor productivity and quality of service.
Competencies:

• Curious about Identity Lifecycle, SSO, authentication models, and security concepts, SOD, GDPR
• Willing to understand the current IAM technologies with an interest in emerging technologies within the IAM space
• teamplayer
• Learn how to build strong relationships and collaboration skills.
• Develop analytical skills and attention to detail
• Interest in tools providing access control, authentication, and authorization, such as SailPoint, CyberArk, Active Directory,Ping, ….
• Interest in Cloud service providers such as AWS, SalesForce and EntraId

Required:

• A passion for and deep understanding of technology risk and information security
• Bachelor's or Master's degree in IT, Computer Science, Engineering or equivalent work experience
• # years of information security experience, compliance and risk management, including privacy, data protection, security controls, etc...
• Demonstrated understanding of modern Identity & Access Management concepts and best practices
• Demonstrated understanding in formulating strategies, alternatives and recommendations in information security management.
• Knowledge of industry regulatory environment and risk management practices (not mandatory but is an asset)
• Demonstrated ability to think critically about risks and clearly articulate prevention and detection mechanisms to key partners.
• Excellent analytical, problem solving and organizational skills with a focused attention to detail.
• Proficient verbal and written communication skills, including the ability to effectively lead discussions and meetings.
• Experience in Business role modelling (not mandatory but is an asset)
• Diplomatic attitude
• team player
• Fluent in English (written and spoken) + fluent in Dutch and/or French

Responsibilities

• Elicit, challenge and document business requirements from Finance stakeholders, including FP&A, Business Controllers and Consolidation teams.
• Translate business needs into clear functional requirements and support solution design activities.
• Analyze processes, data flows and business challenges to identify effective solutions.
• Work with finance stakeholders to understand reporting, planning, consolidation and performance management requirements.
• Facilitate communication between business users, project teams and technical experts.
• Participate in functional analysis, testing and validation activities to ensure successful delivery of key project milestones.
• Support data analysis and reconciliation efforts where required.
• Bring structure and clarity to complex situations while supporting multiple initiatives and shifting priorities.

Requirements

• You have 3+ years of experience as a Business Analyst in a fast-paced corporate environment.
• You hold a Bachelor's or Master's degree, or equivalent experience and analytical level.
• You bring solid experience with requirements gathering and functional analysis.
• You possess a good understanding of finance terminology and financial processes andyou can communicate confidently with Business Controllers, FP&A teams and other Finance stakeholders.
• You excel at Excel
• You work independently and proactively with limited guidance, and take ownership rather than waiting for detailed instructions.
• You're comfortable in a dynamic and sometimes ambiguous environment where not all requirements are defined upfront.
• You're a fast learner with a strong problem-solving and analytical mindset.
• You are fluent in English.
Nice to Haves

• Experience with OneStream or similar performance management and consolidation tools.
• Exposure to Snowflake and basic SQL knowledge.
• Experience supporting finance transformation programs.
• Knowledge of data reconciliation and data quality processes.
• Experience in telecommunications, utilities or other large corporate environments.
• Knowledge of Dutch.

Responsibilities

On behalf of our client, an international industrial group, we are looking for an AI Engineer to join its central Data Science & AI Engineering team. The team is part of corporate R&D and delivers projects for business units worldwide. It combines specialists in agentic AI, time series and computer vision, and works directly with scientists, process engineers and business owners.

The team runs its own agentic platform on Azure with a custom agent harness. It already supports several use cases in production, from finance processes to research assistants that query scientific and operational databases. The next phase is underway: more use cases in parallel, more data sources connected, and a larger library of shared skills and tools. You will build those agents and strengthen the platform underneath them.

WHAT YOU WILL DO

Agent development

• Design and build agents that carry complex, domain-specific logic, translating expert knowledge from scientists and engineers into reasoning steps, tools and guardrails
• Build multi-step and multi-agent workflows with LangGraph, combining retrieval, tool calls and business rules
• Connect agents to structured enterprise data in Databricks, often combining several sources in one solution
Context and knowledge management

• Define what context an agent needs to reason correctly: instructions, retrieved documents, table and column descriptions, domain rules
• Improve metadata on the data platform so tables and fields are described well enough for agents to use them reliably
• Design retrieval and grounding strategies that keep answers traceable to their source
Skills and tooling

• Build reusable skills and tools that agents across use cases can share
• Decide which agent gets which tools and permissions, and keep the tool library maintainable
Evaluation and quality

• Set up structured evaluation of agent behaviour: test sets, metrics, regression checks and human review
• Use evaluation results to improve prompts, tools and architecture, and report quality clearly to stakeholders
Delivery and collaboration

• Deliver solutions on Azure and Databricks, with IT owning integration and operations
• Contribute to platform architecture decisions and engineering standards
• Follow developments in LLMs and agent frameworks and assess what is worth adopting

Requirements

• Master's degree in Computer Science, or a PhD in Mathematics or a related quantitative field
• 3+ years of hands-on software or AI engineering, including building agentic or LLM-based systems
• At least one agentic application delivered to production that goes well beyond a chatbot or summarisation tool
• Real production experience on Azure and Databricks
• Strong Python and solid software engineering practice: testing, version control, code review, clean architecture
• Hands-on experience with LangGraph or a comparable orchestration framework, and with OpenAI or similar models
• Experience with RAG, tool calling and structured evaluation of LLM output
• Backend and data focus: you are comfortable working with data platforms, APIs and system architecture
• Clear communication in English with technical and non-technical stakeholders
Nice to have:

• Experience in an industrial, manufacturing, chemical or process environment
• Azure OpenAI, MLflow, Unity Catalog - Experience building shared platforms or internal developer tooling
What you get:

• Complex, company-specific problems with access to real industrial data
• Room to explore and build, without operational load: once a solution is built, IT takes over operations
• A multidisciplinary team where you learn from colleagues in vision AI, time series and process modelling
• Involvement in research projects with external partners

What will you do?
• Lead the technical design, development and maintenance of a scalable and secure SaaS platform, making future-proof architectural decisions.
• Develop new features end-to-end, perform code reviews and continuously improve the platform's performance, reliability and maintainability.
• Contribute to the technical roadmap, evaluate architectural approaches and leverage innovative technologies, including AI tools, to continuously improve both the software and development processes.  
What are they looking for?
• You bring a minimum of 10 years of experience in software engineering and have built up strong expertise in software architecture. You live in Belgium and are legally authorized to work here.
• You have strong expertise in .NET and C#, combined with experience in fornt-end development. You look beyond the code itself and know how to apply the right architectural principles and design patterns based on the platform's needs.
• You take initiative, enjoy solving challenges and feel at home in an entrepreneurial scale-up environment. You have excellent communication skills in English.

What you will do
 

IMEC performs world-leading research in nano-electronics, operating a diverse equipment set of most advanced semiconductor wafer processing models. To improve and further roll out our CIM application landscape, we have started the Smart Fab initiative in 2024. Smart Fab is not only about simplification of manual work, it also will deliver more insight into capacity utilization, as well as product quality. You will become part of this journey in a growing team, providing opportunities in an exciting environment.
 
 

• As a member of our Smart Fab team, you will closely work with business analysts and software developers for our equipment integration solution. You will be supported by dedicated test engineers. 

• You will receive industry specific training and can rely on experienced teammates. 

• You perform the crucial task of analyzing how our equipment integration software platform can implement business requirements. The specifications to be passed on to internal and more often external developers can range from straightforward configuration to additional logic to be defined. 

• Some business requirements will result in equipment integration being dependent on related configuration or even features to be implemented in adjacent applications, especially the MES. You thus will gain sufficient knowledge about adjacent CIM applications to effectively collaborate with their business analysts and functional analysts. 

• You have an active role in test preparation and debugging. You will be supported by our PMO team during all phases of the software lifecycle. 

Who you are
 
 

• You have a master’s degree in engineering, exact sciences, or equal by experience. 

• You bring 5 years or more of experience in a complex manufacturing environment, characterized by demanding processes, high product mix, and delicate materials. 

• Prior experience in, or knowledge of, semiconductor manufacturing is a strong asset, preferably in a 300 mm Fab. 

• You have participated in a CIM project, understanding concepts like the automation pyramid and equipment state engines, as well as standards like OPC or SECS. 

• You have strong analytical skills and are solution oriented. You can challenge assumptions and question approaches. 

• You can work independently and in a team. You do work diligently and are dependable. 

• You feel comfortable in a complex environment. 

• Since you will be working in a highly international environment and will be maintaining a good contact with colleagues and co-workers from all over the world, fluency in English is essential.

What you will do
 

IMEC performs world-leading research in nano-electronics, operating a diverse equipment set of most advanced semiconductor wafer processing models. To improve and further roll out our CIM application landscape, we have started the Smart Fab initiative in 2024. Smart Fab is not only about simplification of manual work, it also will deliver more insight into capacity utilization, as well as product quality. You will become part of this journey in a growing team, providing opportunities in an exciting environment. 
 
 

• As a member of our Smart Fab team, you will closely work with equipment engineers and software developers.  

• You will receive industry specific training and can rely on experienced teammates.  

• You will follow Fab Operations to understand the different levels of automation currently implemented in our cleanrooms.  

• Your initial task will be the verification of equipment to host communication as specified during purchasing. Semiconductor equipment communication follows a comprehensive set of standards. However, these standards allow for differences in implementation and scope definition which often cause complications with equipment integration.  

• Once more experienced, you will play a decisive role in exploring equipment behavior at the communication interfaces under different operational scenarios.  

• Your test results are not just necessary for bug fixing. They are crucial input for equipment integration developers in the first place.  

• You will contribute to improving our test methodology, utilizing dedicated test software as well as equipment simulators. 

Who you are
 
 

• You bring 5 years or more of experience in software development and testing, specifically related to hardware automation.  

• Prior experience in, or knowledge of, semiconductor manufacturing is a strong asset, preferably in a 300 mm Fab.  

• You did apply concepts like the automation pyramid and equipment state engines, as well as standards like OPC or SECS. You understand the difference between instructions and reports. You know how to analyze data exchange with hardware units and debug communication issues.  

• You have strong analytical skills, are self-critical, and solution oriented.  

• You can work independently and in a team. You do work diligently and are persistent.  

• Prior experience in a cooperative setup, original software supplier's engineers sharing the workload with in-house developers, as well as onsite-remote hybrid collaboration, is highly desired.  

• You feel comfortable in a complex environment.  

• Since you will be working in a highly international environment and will be maintaining a good contact with colleagues and co-workers from all over the world, fluency in English is essential.

What you will do
 

You will be a member of the Defect Inspection Engineer team (DIE) which is part of the Inspection and Metrology Characterization group (IMC). The IMC group is responsible for the metrology and defectivity process portfolio and tools and follows up processes under evaluation/validation for furture needs. As process engineer in the DIE team, you will be responsible for tools and processes:
 
 

• Process & tool qualification, monitor stability, implement improvements for improved quality and cycle time. 

• Troubleshooting defectivity related issues reported by the First Line Support which cannot be resolved by themselves. 

• Analyze data utilizing sound statistical methods and present summaries to peers and management. 

• Fulfill requests for new applications and create the tool recipes. 

• Investigate tool and recipe issues, focus on root cause analysis and development of long-term solutions. 

• Utilizing expert interpersonal skills, collaborate in a dynamic multidisciplinary and multicultural environment in close cooperation with researchers, hardware engineers, operations, industry assignees, device and process experts. 

• As opportunities arise, innovate new techniques of characterization that align with the Imec’s technology roadmap. 

• You will work in two shifts (early/late) including one weekend out of four (Sa/Su), to support the 24h by 7d fab. 

Who you are
 
 

• You obtained a Master in Science or Engineering or equal by experience and display strong engineering skills and mindset. 

• Experience in a FAB environment is a strong asset. 

• You are data driven and seek out information before making decisions and taking action. 

• You like to work autonomously, well organized, with good attention to detail and set high standards for quality. 

• You speak fluent English. 

• As you will work in cross functional teams, strong communication and reporting skills are required. You are a team player with strong drive to share your expertise and knowledge with colleagues. You strive to document and report.

What you will do 
 
 

• As a member of our Smart Fab team, you will closely work with developers of the same and adjacent software applications, Functional Analysts, and Business Analysts, to deliver a modern CIM application landscape.  

• Your primary contact will be the developer team lead, responsible for establishing our in-house development capability for the commercially sourced Equipment Integration platform, and we will assign an additional mentor during your onboarding.  

• You will follow Fab Operations to understand the different levels of automation currently implemented in our cleanrooms.  

• Your initial tasks will be configuration of existing equipment controller software modules, followed by developing clones of software modules for the same equipment type.  

• As we insource more functionality of the commercially sourced Equipment Integration platform, you will start developing equipment controller software modules for new equipment types. You will also be involved in developing custom solutions interfacing with the commercial platform.  

• You will participate in equipment model testing, both with software emulators as well as physical connection to the equipment hardware.  

Who you are 
 
 

• You bring 5 years or more of experience in software development, specifically related to hardware automation, and performing Java OOP.  

• Prior experience in, or knowledge of, semiconductor manufacturing is a strong asset, preferably in a 300 mm Fab.  

• You understand concepts like the automation pyramid and equipment state engines, as well as standards like OPC or SECS.  

• You can work independently and in a team. You do work diligently and are persistent.  

• Prior experience in a cooperative setup, original software supplier's engineers sharing the workload with in-house developers, as well as onsite-remote hybrid collaboration, is highly desired.  

• You feel comfortable in a complex and demanding environment.  

• Since you will be working in a highly international environment and will be maintaining a good contact with colleagues and co-workers from all over the world, fluency in English is essential.

What you will do 
 

You will join our SEM-TEM operations team within the FAB, where we perform both in-line and out-of-line electron microscopy inspections. These inspections are essential at various stages of process development, enabling us to characterise materials and processes at wafer level with a high degree of precision. By delivering accurate and timely insights, we support our internal customers in developing innovative chip manufacturing processes that meet ever more demanding requirements. To achieve this, we rely on cutting-edge cleanroom facilities and highly advanced equipment. In this role, you will help ensure the health, quality and reliability of our microscopy tools through close collaboration with equipment suppliers and internal users. In short, you will support the teams carrying out microscopy analyses and contribute to the smooth and high-quality execution of SEM and TEM inspections. 
 
 

• As a SEM/TEM Hardware Assistant Technician, your key responsibilities will include:  

• Monitoring and following up on the overall health and performance of the tools.  

• Acting as the main point of contact with equipment suppliers to report, discuss and resolve tool-related issues.  

• Serving as the first point of contact for internal users when tool health or performance issues arise.  

• Contributing to the achievement of hardware performance targets and key performance indicators (KPIs).  

• Supporting statistical process control (SPC) activities for TEM tools to help maintain stable and reliable performance.  

Who you are 
 
 

• You hold a bachelor’s degree in a scientific field such as physics, engineering, chemistry, or another relevant discipline. (or equivalent by relevant experience)  

• Hands-on experience with laboratory tools, microscopy equipment or micromachining systems would be a strong advantage.  

• You are well organised, able to plan effectively, and comfortable working in a fast-paced environment where multitasking and setting priorities are essential.  

• You are a communicative team player with a good command of English.  

• You are willing to work in a shift system, including early, late and night shifts, (24/7) as well as one weekend in four.

Shape the architecture behind the next generation of AI supercomputers.
 

Join imec and design the future of AI computing
 

What if your architectural decisions could influence the future of artificial intelligence at the scale of the world's most advanced computing systems?
At imec, you will work at the intersection of AI, semiconductor innovation, and large-scale computing architectures. Together with leading experts in computing systems, chip technology, software, and artificial intelligence, you will help define how future AI infrastructure is built, optimized, and scaled.
This is not a product maintenance role. It is an opportunity to explore breakthrough architectures that could shape the next decade of AI and high-performance computing.
 

What you will do
 

As a Principal AI & High-Performance Computing Architect, you will drive innovation across the entire computing stack, from AI applications and system software to processors, accelerators, and semiconductor technologies.
You will create models, simulations, and design explorations that help identify the most promising paths toward future AI computing systems that deliver significant improvements in performance, energy efficiency, and sustainability.
Your responsibilities include:
 
 

• Exploring architectural solutions for next-generation AI and high-performance computing clusters. 

• Analysing the behaviour and performance characteristics of large-scale AI workloads. 

• Developing performance models that identify bottlenecks and opportunities for innovation. 

• Evaluating future processor, accelerator, memory, and system designs. 

• Collaborating with experts in computer architecture, AI, semiconductor technology, system software, and modelling. 

• Defining requirements for future AI computing platforms and processor architectures. 

• Guiding strategic research directions through data-driven performance analysis and projections. 

• Contributing to breakthrough innovations that improve performance, energy efficiency, operational cost, and environmental impact. 

Who you are
 
 

• Master’s or PhD degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering or relevant STEM degree, with at least around 8 years of experience.   

• Experience with performance analysis, engineering, and optimization of HPC applications, such as molecular dynamics and computational fluid dynamics,  

• Experience in AI for HPC is a plus.   

• Experience with distributed AI/ML applications, such as LLM training and inference.   

• Experience in system performance modeling ranging from a single device (e.g. a GPU) to a machine scale (e.g. a cluster).  

• Good understanding of GPU (preferably XPU) system architectures, distributed programming models, runtime resource management, and microarchitecture.   

• Strong programming ability in C++ and Python. CUDA knowledge is considered a plus.   

• Your communication and interpersonal skills enable you to work in a dynamic, distributed team. You actively share experiences and knowledge with colleagues. A history of mentoring more junior engineers and interns is a huge plus.   

• We are looking for your excellent communication skills in English, as you will work in a multicultural team and together with our partners.
